items.name: Change Symbol
items.desc: Standard change key cylinder. Keys unique to each door.

items.name: SKD (Single Keyed Different)
items.desc: Same as a change key but called out separately on the order.

items.name: KA (Keyed Alike)
items.desc: Multiple cylinders sharing the same key. Often specified per group.

items.name: Master Symbol
items.desc: Cylinder keyed under a master. No keys ship with the cylinder itself.

items.name: Selective Master Cylinder
items.desc: Cross-keyed to a selective master path.

items.name:
X--X Cross-Keyed 
(no own key)
items.desc: Cross-keyed cylinder with no change key of its own.

items.name: X-- Cross-Keyed WITH Own Key
items.desc: Cross-keyed cylinder that also has its own change key symbol.

items.name:
X-Prefix + Symbol 
(e.g. XLA12)
items.desc: Pinning is same as the base symbol. The X just documents the cross-keying. Keys are included.

items.name: LKB (Less Key Blank)
items.desc: Cylinder is pinned but no physical keys ship.

items.note: must add extractor tool and ship 2nd day air pm
items.name:
Construction Key Core (CK) 
Split Key
items.desc: Core furnished without keys. Operating and control keys must be added manually.

items.name: Zero/One Bitted
items.desc: Cylinder shipped with all pins at zero. No operating key, used for temporary or field re-key.

items.name: Control Key
items.desc: always include 1 control key with new 7 pin systems
